cards.mood: The piece opens with a floating, meditative stillness, establishing a sense of vast, open space.
cards.vocal: A single female vocalist delivers the performance with an exceptionally airy, breathy, and crystalline timbre.
cards.palette: A lush, evolving synthesizer pad serves as the harmonic bedrock, present from the very beginning to the end.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Silver mist hangs in the heavy air
Soft light dances on the silent stone
The world is breathing in a velvet hush
Time dissolves like salt in a deep lake
[Pre-Chorus]
A single leaf begins to drift
The morning stars start to fade
[Chorus]
Floating through the space between the sighs
Where the earth meets the endless blue
Finding peace in the quiet light
Drifting home to a center true
[Verse]
Petals open to the waking moon
Shadows stretch across the mossy ground
Every heartbeat is a rhythmic pulse
The mountain speaks in a hidden tongue
[Pre-Chorus]
A gentle wind begins to hum
The heavy clouds begin to part
[Chorus]
Floating through the space between the sighs
Where the earth meets the endless blue
Finding peace in the quiet light
Drifting home to a center true
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The spirit rises like a steady flame
The soul becomes a silent song
[Chorus]
Floating through the space between the sighs
Where the earth meets the endless blue
Finding peace in the quiet light
Drifting home to a center true
[Outro]
